definitions.HU: Home University area — seats for Maharashtra State candidates whose Home University matches the institute's university jurisdiction (brochure rule 2 / CAP allotment).
definitions.OHU: Outside Home University (OHU) — seats for Maharashtra State candidates whose Home University is other than the institute's university area.
definitions.STATE: State Level seats — filled statewide among eligible Maharashtra State candidates (not limited to a single Home University tag), as allotted in CAP.

TFWS.summary: Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme seats are supernumerary (up to 5% of sanctioned intake where eligible). Only Maharashtra State Candidature candidates whose parent's annual income from all sources is less than Rs. 8 Lakh are eligible. Income certificate from competent Maharashtra authority required. Course/institution change not allowed after TFWS admission.

EWS.summary: 10% seats reserved for Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates (Maharashtra State), over and above sanctioned intake, filled through CAP as per Government policy. Valid EWS certificate required.

PWD.summary: Persons with Disability seats: disability must be permanent and not less than 40%. Certificate from competent authority required. Available for Maharashtra domiciled candidates in HU / State Level seats. Single inter-se merit list of eligible PWD candidates.

DEF.summary: Defence category seats require qualifying defence-category documents as specified in the brochure (Proformas). Verify current-year CAP document list before preferring DEF codes.

ORPHAN.summary: One percent (1%) of CAP seats (excluding Minority institutions and All India seats, if any) reserved for Orphan Candidates, filled through CAP as per Women and Child Welfare Department GR.

MI.summary: Minority Quota seats are for Maharashtra-domiciled linguistic or religious minority candidates as notified by the Government. Minority declaration / leaving certificate and domicile (or Type A docs) required.

cap_process_summary: CAP allotment for Maharashtra State candidates uses Inter-Se-Merit, filled options, and seats available at each stage of Rounds I–IV.
Home University (HU), Other than Home University (OHU), and State Level seats are allotted with HU/OHU tags; if seats remain vacant, stages may run without HU/OHU tags.
Candidates eligible for a stage are considered even if allotted or not allotted in a previous stage; upward shift is possible as seats open.
Cutoff percentiles in this app are historical evidence only — actual allotment follows CET Cell merit lists and the brochure stages, not these band labels.
disclaimer: Rule notes are condensed from the official CET Information Brochure 2026-27 for counselling guidance. Always verify the latest CET Cell notifications and your documents.
